headword: {時代小説|じだいしょうせつ}

definitions.gloss: period novel; historical fiction (set in premodern Japan)
definitions.explanation: A novel set in premodern Japan, typically the Edo period, that uses the period as a backdrop for invented characters and adventures.

examples.english: My father reads period novels before he goes to sleep.
